title: Copia y personaliza el prompt de Seedance 2.0 incorporando los cambios que…
content:
Copia y personaliza el prompt de Seedance 2.0 incorporando los cambios que hiciste en el paso 1 al generar la imagen (Nano Banana) para mantener coherencia visual.  
Si no dominas el inglés, usa cualquier LLM para traducir/mejorar el prompt antes de generar en Seedance.  
Estructura el prompt por secciones (CINEMATIC SETUP / IMAGE REFERENCES / TIMELINE SECOND BY SECOND / STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS / NEGATIVES) para controlar look, referencias, acciones por tiempo, calidad y errores.  
Incluye una referencia de imagen como Starting frame reference (Ref 1) y exige “Exact starting frame match” para que el video arranque idéntico a la imagen.  
Define el video con un timeline segundo a segundo (p. ej., 0–3s, 3–6s, 6–10s) especificando tipo de plano y acciones para guiar la puesta en escena.  
Para evitar personajes extra, añade restricciones explícitas como “The camera frames only these specific individuals; no other players enter the shot” y refuérzalo con negativos (duplicate players, extra players in frame, cloned characters).  
Mejora realismo de broadcast añadiendo “telephoto broadcast lens”, “realistic TV camera movement”, “subtle motion blur”, “slight TV compression artifacts” y “faint interlaced TV grain”.  
Para consistencia de identidad y estabilidad, incluye “movie-level stable facial features keeping the identity” y “coherent multi-character interaction”.  
Para física creíble, añade “Extremely realistic physics on hair and clothing” y bloquea fallos con negativos como unrealistic physics, floating elements, robotic movements.  
Incluye una lista de NEGATIVES (deformed faces, blurry motion, low resolution, text artifacts, watermark, extra limbs, CGI look, cartoonish) para reducir artefactos comunes.

en.content:
Copy and customize the Seedance 2.0 prompt by incorporating the changes you made in step 1 when generating the image (Nano Banana) to maintain visual coherence.  
If you're not proficient in English, use any LLM to translate/improve the prompt before generating in Seedance.  
Structure the prompt by sections (CINEMATIC SETUP / IMAGE REFERENCES / TIMELINE SECOND BY SECOND / STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS / NEGATIVES) to control look, references, actions by time, quality, and errors.  
Include an image reference as Starting frame reference (Ref 1) and require “Exact starting frame match” so the video starts identical to the image.  
Define the video with a second-by-second timeline (e.g., 0–3s, 3–6s, 6–10s) specifying shot type and actions to guide the staging.  
To avoid extra characters, add explicit restrictions like “The camera frames only these specific individuals; no other players enter the shot” and reinforce it with negatives (duplicate players, extra players in frame, cloned characters).  
Enhance broadcast realism by adding “telephoto broadcast lens”, “realistic TV camera movement”, “subtle motion blur”, “slight TV compression artifacts” and “faint interlaced TV grain”.  
For identity consistency and stability, include “movie-level stable facial features keeping the identity” and “coherent multi-character interaction”.  
For believable physics, add “Extremely realistic physics on hair and clothing” and block failures with negatives like unrealistic physics, floating elements, robotic movements.  
Include a list of NEGATIVES (deformed faces, blurry motion, low resolution, text artifacts, watermark, extra limbs, CGI look, cartoonish) to reduce common artifacts.

ja.content:
Seedance 2.0のプロンプトをコピーしてカスタマイズし、ステップ1で行った変更を取り入れて画像（Nano Banana）を生成し、視覚的一貫性を保ちます。  
英語が得意でない場合は、Seedanceで生成する前に、任意のLLMを使用してプロンプトを翻訳/改善してください。  
プロンプトをセクションごとに構成します（CINEMATIC SETUP / IMAGE REFERENCES / TIMELINE SECOND BY SECOND / STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS / NEGATIVES）で、ルック、参照、時間ごとのアクション、品質、エラーを制御します。  
画像の参照をStarting frame reference (Ref 1)として含め、ビデオが画像と同一に始まるように“Exact starting frame match”を要求します。  
ビデオを秒単位のタイムラインで定義し（例：0–3秒、3–6秒、6–10秒）、シーン設定を導くためのショットタイプとアクションを指定します。  
余分なキャラクターを避けるために、“The camera frames only these specific individuals; no other players enter the shot”のような明確な制約を追加し、negatives（duplicate players, extra players in frame, cloned characters）で強化します。  
放送のリアリズムを向上させるために、“telephoto broadcast lens”, “realistic TV camera movement”, “subtle motion blur”, “slight TV compression artifacts”および“faint interlaced TV grain”を追加します。  
アイデンティティと安定性の一貫性を保つために、“movie-level stable facial features keeping the identity”および“coherent multi-character interaction”を含めます。  
信頼できる物理を実現するために、“Extremely realistic physics on hair and clothing”を追加し、unrealistic physics, floating elements, robotic movementsのようなnegativesで失敗を防ぎます。  
一般的なアーティファクトを減らすために、NEGATIVES（deformed faces, blurry motion, low resolution, text artifacts, watermark, extra limbs, CGI look, cartoonish）のリストを含めます。

ko.content:
Seedance 2.0의 프롬프트를 복사하고 개인화하여 이미지 생성 시 1단계에서 수행한 변경 사항(Nano Banana)을 통합하여 시각적 일관성을 유지하세요.  
영어에 능숙하지 않다면, Seedance에서 생성하기 전에 프롬프트를 번역/개선하기 위해 어떤 LLM이든 사용하세요.  
프롬프트를 섹션별로 구조화하세요 (CINEMATIC SETUP / IMAGE REFERENCES / TIMELINE SECOND BY SECOND / STYLE & QUALITY BOOSTERS / NEGATIVES) 하여 외형, 참조, 시간별 행동, 품질 및 오류를 제어하세요.  
시작 프레임 참조(Ref 1)로 이미지 참조를 포함하고, 비디오가 이미지와 동일하게 시작하도록 "Exact starting frame match"를 요구하세요.  
비디오를 초 단위로 타임라인(예: 0–3초, 3–6초, 6–10초)으로 정의하고, 장면 설정을 안내하기 위해 샷 유형과 행동을 명시하세요.  
추가 캐릭터를 피하기 위해 "The camera frames only these specific individuals; no other players enter the shot"와 같은 명확한 제한을 추가하고, 부정적 요소(duplicate players, extra players in frame, cloned characters)로 강화하세요.  
방송의 현실감을 높이기 위해 "telephoto broadcast lens", "realistic TV camera movement", "subtle motion blur", "slight TV compression artifacts" 및 "faint interlaced TV grain"을 추가하세요.  
정체성과 안정성의 일관성을 위해 "movie-level stable facial features keeping the identity"와 "coherent multi-character interaction"을 포함하세요.  
신뢰할 수 있는 물리적 표현을 위해 "Extremely realistic physics on hair and clothing"을 추가하고, 비현실적인 물리학, 떠다니는 요소, 로봇 같은 움직임과 같은 부정적 요소로 오류를 차단하세요.  
일반적인 아티팩트를 줄이기 위해 NEGATIVES 목록(deformed faces, blurry motion, low resolution, text artifacts, watermark, extra limbs, CGI look, cartoonish)을 포함하세요.
